ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited announced the commissioning of an additional 16.06 MW / 69.678 MWh discharge capacity for its FDRE Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project in Rajasthan, with a Commercial Operation Date (COD) of November 22, 2026. This positive operational milestone advances the subsidiary's cumulative commissioned capacity to 175.72 MW / 733.939 MWh, demonstrating steady progress towards the full 250 MW project. No red flags are identified, as this update signifies continued project execution and movement towards revenue generation.
